name: Proton11-ARM64-A57-v80
why: Steam validates and updates Valve's own 'Proton 11.0 (ARM64)' and so undoes any change made to it, but never touches a tool under compatibilitytools.d. This is the community standalone ARMv8.0 build of proton-11.0-1 (-march=armv8-a): the H700's Cortex-A53 has no LSE atomics. docs/WISPOS-NOTES.md, DESIGN FINDING.
